title: CompositionGraph v0.1
description: The ORCHESTRATION artifact of the Open Agent Continuum (ADR-0001): how many governed agents/organs compose into ONE bounded, receipted workflow DAG. Where GenesisSeed (schemas/genesis-seed.schema.json) is the formation charter of a SINGLE twin, a CompositionGraph is the plural — a Triune/AUM-style DAG whose nodes are seeded agent-roles with a capability envelope, a time-box and a danger class, whose edges are data/control dependencies, and whose gates are references to the policy/eval/quorum machinery the estate already owns. Consume-not-fork: each node's seed_ref binds a GenesisSeed (which instantiates a WorkspaceMountTable, f*); gates reference Sentinel policy + SEC-2 witness-quorum; the whole run is a hash-chained ProofArtifact on the proof-artifact-spine (f_!, AC-1); tool_exec nodes route through agent-term's disposable-VM controller; the epistemic ceiling is computed by tools/workspace-controller. Grounded in the Agentic Composition/Orchestration + Inception Framework intake (2026-08-03) and the estate's receipt/epistemic/loops-vs-DAGs laws.
$comment: Cross-field rules enforced by tools/validate_composition_graph.py (not expressible in pure JSON Schema): (1) node_id unique; edges/gates reference declared node_ids; (2) graph-level control flow is ACYCLIC — a cycle is legal ONLY inside a node declared loop:true carrying budget.max_iterations (loops-vs-DAGs-governed: DAG=acyclic identity, loop=correction bounded+convergent+fail-closed); (3) a loop node MUST carry budget.max_iterations, a non-loop node MUST NOT; (4) fail-closed actuation — any node with danger_class 'high' or a mutating/host provider (provider:kubernetes | provider:host | *host_update*) MUST be covered by a quorum gate; (5) kill_switch, receipt per_node/run, and append-only provenance are pinned as consts below AND re-checked here so the two cannot silently drift.

graph_id.description: Stable unique identifier and version, e.g. composition:deploy-pipeline/v1. A composition is a versioned artifact (changes require provenance).

federation_profile.description: Whether/how nodes may cooperate with peer twins across domains. A composition cannot self-declare unbounded federation — start same-domain only (ADR federation gate). Same closed enum as GenesisSeed.

revocation.description: Blast-radius containment. kill_switch MUST be true — a composition without an instant mass-terminate path is a bug (the swarm's A2A REVOKE + kill-by-label).

scope.description: How termination is addressed: by node label (process/pod), by A2A grant, or both.

kill_switch.description: MUST be true — mandatory instant mass-terminate (enforced here AND in tools/validate_composition_graph.py).

receipt_profile.description: Receipting posture. A composition run IS a ProofArtifact (WO-B, AC-1): every publishing node is receipted and the run carries a hash-chained receipt; provenance is append-only.

per_node.description: MUST be true — every publishing node emits a receipt (AC-1).

run.description: MUST be true — the composition run emits a run-level ProofArtifact (AC-1).

provenance.description: MUST be append_only — provenance is never rewritten (spec 7.4 / AC-1).

nodes.description: The agent-roles composed by this graph. Each is an instance of a GenesisSeed (seed_ref) with a capability envelope, a time-box and a danger class.

edges.description: Data/control dependencies between nodes. Graph-level edges MUST be acyclic (see $comment); the only legal cycles are bounded loop nodes.

gates.description: Policy/eval/quorum gates that must pass. Gates REFERENCE the estate's engines (Sentinel policy, SEC-2 witness-quorum) — they are not a new engine.

seed_ref.description: The GenesisSeed (schemas/genesis-seed.schema.json) that FORMS this node's twin, e.g. seed:operator/deploy-v1. The node instantiates the seed; it does not re-declare its profiles (consume-not-fork).

archetype.description: Optional free-text role label (collector/curator/retriever/generator/verifier/…) until the organ-mesh archetype enum formalises (post-WO-D).

organs.description: The capability modules this node exercises — a subset of its seed's organs_allowed (resolved at bind time).

danger_class.description: Side-effect risk. 'high' forces quorum-gate coverage (fail-closed actuation).

ttl_seconds.description: The node's bounded lifetime — every node is time-boxed (systemd RuntimeMaxSec / k8s ttlSecondsAfterFinished). No unbounded residency.

loop.description: If true, this node runs a bounded correction loop (rewrite→retrieve→generate→evaluate→gate) and MUST carry budget.max_iterations; the only legal cycle in the graph. Defaults to false.

budget.description: Iteration budget for a loop node. Required iff loop:true (enforced by the validator).

max_iterations.description: Hard upper bound on loop iterations — a loop must be bounded and convergent.

provider_profile.description: External service bindings this node may use, e.g. provider:kubernetes. A mutating/host provider forces quorum-gate coverage (same rule as GenesisSeed's host_mutation gate).

approval.description: What requires human review/co-signature for this node, keyed by action kind, e.g. {"host_mutation": "required"}.

kind.description: data = output feeds input; control = ordering/gating dependency.

gate_id.description: Reference to the concrete gate, e.g. policy:deploy/base, eval:rag/faithfulness, quorum:human/2of3 (Sentinel / SEC-2 witness-quorum).

kind.description: policy = Sentinel/OPA allow/deny; eval = quality threshold; quorum = human co-signature (SEC-2 witness-quorum).

applies_to.description: node_ids this gate covers. Every id must be a declared node.
